texts.9b52d2ab8e53: The overall aim of the trial is to provide data required for an informed decision about the introduction of population screening for lung cancer. This involves establishing the impact of screening on lung cancer mortality, determining the best screening strategy and assessing the physical and psychological consequences and the health economic implications of screening. A further objective is to create a resource for future improvements to screening strategies.
